target: national monthly median maize modal price, Rs/quintal

feature_reasoning.lag_1_lag_2_lag_3_lag_12: Previous observed national monthly prices; available for a rolling one-month-ahead forecast.
feature_reasoning.month: Calendar seasonality; treated as a category with one-hot encoding.
feature_reasoning.year: A simple long-term time trend; extrapolation beyond the observed period is uncertain.
feature_reasoning.excluded_fields: State, district, market and commodity are not inputs because the modeled target is a national maize aggregate. Arrivals and same-month min/max prices are contemporaneous with the target and could leak information.

split.test_protocol: Rolling one-month-ahead; the previous actual month is available before the next month's prediction.

interpretation: Compare MAE/RMSE/R2 with the baselines; a larger MAE or RMSE than persistence means the learned model is worse for this evaluation.
